name: Sentinel Agent
description: An external agent running on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore integrated with Workday via MCP protocol

skills.name: Skill 1: Inventory operatives, open positions, organizations
skills.description: Count active workers, open requisitions and internal job postings by job type, and list organizations.

skills.name: Skill 2: Map the recognition network
skills.description: Find a supervisory organization, list its members, and show which members have received feedback and badges.

skills.name: Skill 3: Reinforce the network
skills.description: Give an operative anytime feedback with a badge. First write to Workday.

workdayResources.description: Find or list workers visible to the signed-in user, with current staffing details.
Read-only. Find, browse or filter job requisitions the signed-in user can access.
Read-only. Browse and filter internal job postings visible to the signed-in user.
Read-only. List the job types that can be used to filter internal job postings.
Read-only. List organizations visible to the signed-in user (supervisory organizations, cost centers, hierarchies).
Find supervisory organizations by search term, or retrieve a single one.
List the filled positions in one supervisory organization, with each position's worker, title, job profile and location.
Read-only. List the anytime feedback a specific worker has received.
Give a worker anytime feedback (comment and badge).
